checks.detail: Production web target built and copied; one required target produced, none skipped.

Fresh production server, controller worker install and offline room reopen; six body/hand model and SIMD/non-SIMD runtime files served with expected MIME and nonzero size; live origin, referrer, MIME-sniffing and frame headers checked.

Actual Chromium origin installed the older worker, kept old active assets and a different room available offline while the new worker waited, activated the new worker after old clients closed, reopened another room offline, and did not cache a room data response.
Offline shell contains no baked-in localhost:3000 origin; worker VM covers incomplete update rollback and secret exclusion.

limitations: Desktop Chromium and local production packaging only; installed physical-phone PWA upgrade remains G15.
These checks cover browser artifact behavior and scoped cache/privacy controls, not independent security validation S16 or final release acceptance G17.
